title: Transitivity of bounded reachability
statement: Fix a nondeterministic machine $N$, a mode, an input word $y$, and a bound $B$. If the codec program has a run from configuration $(l_1,v_1)$ to $(l_2,v_2)$ and a run from $(l_2,v_2)$ to $(l_3,v_3)$, with every configuration before the endpoint of each run satisfying the program's guard and all 21 register values at most $B$, then it has such a run from $(l_1,v_1)$ to $(l_3,v_3)$.
hypotheses_covered: A run from $(l_1,v_1)$ to $(l_2,v_2)$ on input $y$ in mode $mode$, guarded by the specified precondition and register bound $B$
A run from $(l_2,v_2)$ to $(l_3,v_3)$ on the same input, mode, guard, and bound
